fast.change: Refactored the diff function into a command group container.
fast.impact: Removed direct execution logic; now mandates subcommands (show/review).

detailed.change: The implementation has been completely stripped of its core Git diff logic, parameter parsing, and output formatting. It is now transformed into a Typer command group stub that enforces the usage of nested subcommands. The function signature was simplified to only accept the context object, removing the arguments for Git references entirely.
detailed.impact: This is a breaking change for the CLI interface. Existing scripts or users calling 'brain diff [ref1] [ref2]' will now fail with a 'Missing subcommand' error. The system dependency on Git logic has been abstracted away to sub-modules, changing the execution flow from a direct action to a router-style command.
